stumbles.why: The text says execute() retries up to 4 times, which makes 5 attempts. Four 503s followed by failure could mean the fifth attempt also fails, or that only four attempts are made. I can't tell whether this case matches the stated retry count.
The bounds are never given. The text says only that the backoff is jittered, exponential and starts at 0.5 s, with no cap or jitter range. I can't tell what the test checks.

stumbles.quote: Over 40 cold boots on 2026-11-09, 31 hit at least one 503. With the fix, all 40 completed.
stumbles.why: It's unclear whether these are the same 40 boots with and without the fix, or whether the fix was applied for the whole run. Without that, I can't tell what the 31 and the 40 are being compared to.

point: The PR adds retry with jittered exponential backoff, for 503 and 429 only, up to 4 times, to the Turso client's execute(). This fixes cold-start 503s that boot misreported as "auth failed", and the PR backs the fix with a measurement and 6 tests.
